body.title: Remove the date fallbacks in the read paths
body.summary: Replace the fallbacks in the read paths with the resolved anchor and a failure before any write: code-review subject-paths.ts, questions.ts, pending.ts, delivery/graph.ts, and the helper callers in gates.ts, chain.ts and the implement.ts and validate.ts folder lookups. Add the cross-day folder tests for the epic and standalone routes and the missing-anchor tests for these sites.
acceptanceChecks: HLD, LLD, PLAN, BUILD, TESTS and CR written on different days land in one folder on both routes, including delivery grouping
each listed read site fails before any file is created when no anchor exists
subject-paths.ts no longer uses new Date()
the workflow, delivery and code-review tests pass
